root_cause_reproduced: The C10 completion-commit barrier (sdk-session-event-coordinator.ts L3494-3525 and L1736-1805) consults four conjuncts (outstandingAutonomousWork, ownerStillRunningForC10, heldObligationForC10, suppressOriginatingCompletion) and NONE consults the per-job containment classification. C10 authorization therefore depends on OBSERVATION DISAPPEARANCE, not on proven containment (postcondition === 'gone'). The sibling Q5 path (reevaluateDeferredContinuation, L1087-1139) DOES consult it and fails closed. The Elm completion-authority kernel has no containment axis at all (Authority.elm L520-597). The data is already wired (SdkController.ts L2664 / L2683) and simply never asked for on the C10 path.
leading_hypothesis_disproved_for_inciden: The hypothesis 'the terminal observation was consumed and the C10 was authorized over an unresolved containment failure' did NOT occur in this incident: the observation was never consumed (both BCB captures report unconsumedOwnedTerminalResultsForC10 = 1 for the same jobId) and the C10 never committed (submit_and_exit_seen = 2, task_completion_committed = 0; no session-event-turn-complete-completed write in the turn-state provenance). The incident is a HOLD-shaped stall (lastStopReason = stalled_no_progress), not an over-commit.
ablation_conclusion: Rows 1->2 and 3->4 differ ONLY in observation consumption and the C10 outcome flips in both. Rows 2 and 4 have identical C10 outcomes despite different containment truth. C10 authorization depends on observation disappearance, NOT on proven containment. This is an ablation, not a chronological association.
additional_structural_facts: The compact-receipt channel is 'gone'-gated: recordTerminalReceiptFromLifecycle (background-notify-coordinator.ts L3548) ignores anything but 'command_job_terminal_committed', and the manager emits that only on the postcondition === 'gone' path (command-job-manager.ts L2677). A containment-failed job can NEVER leave a compact receipt.
The C1 'terminal_committed' cardinality capture is likewise 'gone'-gated, so the Elm kernel never receives a terminal_committed fact for a containment-failed job.

The BCB drain (consumeNonNotifyTerminalObservation, L2004-2050) validates the owner triple and carries NO containment judgement; a foreign owner can read the terminal fact but cannot drain the obligation.
